name: Plantar Plate Tear of the Lesser MTP Joint
tags: plantar plate tear of the lesser mtp joint
definition: Partial or complete injury of the lesser metatarsophalangeal plantar plate, often causing forefoot pain and progressive toe deviation.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound/MRI can demonstrate plantar-plate tear; weight-bearing radiographs assess alignment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent unstable deformity may require surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli Snayu/Sandhi phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or complete injury of the lesser metatarsophalangeal plantar plate, often causing forefoot pain and progressive toe deviation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
